Appeal of a ruling under the Canada Pens.Please state all the facts about the wor: I worked for Maple Wood Construction Ltd. and performed on-site renovation and carpentry services between January 2023 and December 2023. The ruling determined that I was self-employed and therefore not subject to CPP contributions. I disagree with the ruling because the company exercised control over my daily tasks, provided tools and materials, set fixed work schedules, and directed subcontracting arrangements. I contend that the degree of control, integration into the payer's business and the lack of financial risk demonstrate an employment relationship. I request reversal of the ruling and that CPP payroll contributions be assessed accordingly.
